name: Minato Shuuichirou
source: Arrested and imprisoned for exhibitionism crime, the young boy is sentenced with 10 years in Tulip Prison where he has fateful encounters with irreplaceable comrades and overcomes many hardships to grow up as a person. He can talk to his penis which has ego of its own.
